description.value: King George Donair is an authentic Middle Eastern fast-food restaurant in Surrey serving house-made donairs, slow-cooked lamb shank, crispy falafel, and grilled kebabs using traditional recipes. The Surrey location on 100 Avenue is one of two Metro Vancouver outposts, the other being in New Westminster. Online ordering for pickup or delivery is available, making it a practical calorie stop for cyclists passing through Surrey's commercial strip.
